method.tagger: bge-m3 vectors (Workers AI) and one logistic regression per foundation, trained on 80 % of MFRC comments; gold label = more than half of a comment's annotators.
method.ceiling: Mean F1 of one annotator against another on test comments with three or more annotators; the tagger's comparable figure is its mean F1 against each single annotator. The 95 % intervals resample test comments (1,000 rounds).
method.split: 80/20 by a hash of the comment text, so test comments share subreddits and threads with training comments: an in-domain test.
method.baseline: eMFD: mean dictionary probability of a comment's words, threshold chosen on the train split; English only, fairness compared with equality or proportionality merged.
method.swedish_check: 300 Riksdag passages labelled blind by the owner; Riksdag shares are published only if the Swedish macro-F1 is at least 0.8 times the English one. The Swedish F1 is against one rater, the English against the majority of several, so the check is stricter than like with like.
method.null: Party labels shuffled within year, 999 rounds; between-party spread and a band per party cell.
departures: 2026-10-22: the Riksdag unit is a passage of consecutive sentences packed up to 80 words instead of a paragraph, because the archives mark paragraphs differently by era (HTML, one line break, hard-wrapped print lines) and the registered split left only short speeches eligible in 1996/97-2013/14. Decided at the first draw and committed after the review set was embedded; nothing was labelled yet.

2026-10-22: the threshold grid 0.05-0.95 is coarse for eMFD, whose mean word probabilities lie near 0.1; the baseline kept the pre-registered grid, so its F1 may be lower than a finer grid would give.

2026-10-23: added after review, not registered: 95 % intervals over resampled test comments for the tagger's F1 and its gap to the human ceiling. The split is a random hash of the text, so the English test is in-domain (same subreddits and threads). The Swedish check uses one rater against the English majority label, which is stricter than like with like.

caveat_en: The tagger flags vocabulary that crowdworkers linked to a moral foundation in English Reddit comments. A share is how often that vocabulary appears, not how moral a party or a speech is.
caveat_sv: Klassaren markerar ordförråd som annoterare kopplade till en moralisk grund i engelska Reddit-kommentarer. En andel visar hur ofta det ordförrådet förekommer, inte hur moraliskt ett parti eller ett anförande är.
